summary: The torn/open spot is the sole overt participant, with no expressed repairer or adhesive. Negative Detransitive Infectum presents lack of repairability in parallel with sewing.
The glossary's I Detransitive classification and sense 1 are retained despite the loan-shaped quadriliteral form. No active counterpart, new box or new sense is established.
The German kann man wording does not introduce an overt Turoyo agent or an independent ability verb. No light-verb idiom is attested; source kmišayrəzo vocalism is retained in the ledger.
